llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文优化AZ31镁合金SLM工艺参数，但对生物医用植入物的应力遮挡、多孔结构或疲劳性能缺乏直接讨论。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design for stress shielding, does not involve implant geometry or osseointegration testing, and lacks fatigue and surface morphology analysis relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化AZ31镁合金粉末选区激光熔化工艺参数，提高成形质量。
summary_zh.method: 采用实验设计方法系统研究激光功率、扫描速度等参数对致密度和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: 获得了最优工艺参数，实现了高致密度和良好力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和硬度测试验证优化后样品的力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: This work aims to optimize selective laser melting process parameters for AZ31 magnesium alloy powder to achieve high density and improved mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: A design of experiments approach is employed to systematically investigate the effects of laser power, scanning speed, and other parameters on density and mechanical behavior.
summary_en.result: Optimal process parameters are identified, yielding parts with near-full density and enhanced tensile strength and hardness.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including tensile and hardness measurements validates the performance of the optimized samples.

papers.title: Osteogenic and angiogenic activities of silicon-incorporated TiO
papers.abstract: Osteogenesis and angiogenesis that have interaction in vivo are two pivotal processes for implant osseointegration, so implant surfaces with both enhanced osteogenic and angiogenic activities are in need. Developing silicon (Si) doped TiO2 nanotube array (TNA-Si) coatings shall be a promising strategy to yield favorable implant osseointegration with the combined effects of TiO2 nanotube arrays (TNAs) and Si in the enhancement of both osteogenic and angiogenic activities. To achieve this purpose, TNA-Sis are fabricated through the unique strategy of anodization of magnetron-sputtered TiSi coatings. Under optimized conditions, a highly ordered nanotubular structure with even dispersion of Si throughout the nanotubes in the form of SiO2 can be obtained. Si incorporation has little influence on the nanotube length, but slightly decreases the diameter, thickens the nanotube wall, and increases the hydrophilicity. TNA-Sis show good cytocompatibility to both osteoblasts and endothelial cells (ECs). TNA-Sis show enhanced proliferation, spreading, alkaline phosphatase activity, collagen secretion, and matrix mineralization of osteoblasts. Meanwhile, TNA-Sis induce better EC proliferation, and the conditioned culture media from TNA-Sis generate better angiogenic ability, nitric oxide production, and vascular endothelial growth factor secretion from ECs. In particular, TNA-Si4.6 with the strongest osteogenic and angiogenic activities in the context of the present study is highly promising as the next-generation hard tissue implant coating.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究硅掺杂TiO2纳米管涂层对骨整合的影响，未涉及LPBF制造或机械性能，与AM生物医学材料方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no porous structure or stress shielding analysis, and no as-built surface characterization; focus is solely on surface coating bioactivity via anodization.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过硅掺杂TiO2纳米管涂层增强植入物的骨整合能力。
summary_zh.method: 磁控溅射TiSi涂层结合阳极氧化法制备硅掺杂TiO2纳米管阵列。
summary_zh.result: 硅掺杂促进成骨和血管生成活性，最优硅含量为4.6%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过成骨细胞和内皮细胞的体外实验验证生物活性。

summary_en.motivation: To improve implant osseointegration by developing silicon-doped TiO2 nanotube coatings with combined osteogenic and angiogenic activities.
summary_en.method: Silicon-incorporated TiO2 nanotube arrays were fabricated via anodization of magnetron-sputtered TiSi coatings, achieving uniform Si distribution in the nanotube walls.
summary_en.result: The Si-doped coatings enhanced osteoblast proliferation, differentiation, and mineralization, and promoted endothelial cell angiogenic activity in vitro, with optimal performance at 4.6% Si.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture assays using osteoblasts and endothelial cells confirmed cytocompatibility and bioactivity.
